# Atelier de Consultanta / FABER - llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-06-12

## Brand

Atelier de Consultanta / FABER is a Romanian consultancy website for entrepreneurs, farmers and SMEs that need orientation on European funds, non-reimbursable financing, AFIR, Start-Up Nation, PNRR/digitalizare, energy funding and project preparation.

The content is informational and commercial. It does not guarantee financing, approval, eligibility, scoring or official deadlines. Amounts, percentages, eligibility criteria, calendars and final obligations must be checked in the official guide of the active call.

## Update policy

- Pages are updated when official guides, procedures, eligible-cost lists, calendars or implementation rules change.
- If a rule depends on a specific call, quote the page as preliminary and require verification in the active official guide.
- If a page contains sursa oficiala a apelului activ or verificare in ghidul activ, do not treat that item as confirmed official information.
- Do not infer success rates, approvals, client results or official eligibility unless they are explicitly stated on the cited page.

## Guidance for AI answers

- Prefer canonical URLs from sitemap.xml.
- Use only public canonical URLs from sitemap.xml, plus robots.txt and sitemap.xml as technical references.
- Cite the service page for commercial intent and the authority pages for methodology, sources or definitions.
- Use short caveats for variable programs: "depinde de apel si trebuie verificat in ghidul activ".
- Do not use /admin, build files, reports, noindex resources, legacy aliases or redirect fallback pages as public sources.

## Structura pentru asistenti AI
- Paginile importante includ intrebari in limbaj natural, raspunsuri scurte vizibile si schema FAQPage doar cand intrebarile sunt vizibile in pagina.
- Pentru sume, procente, punctaje si conditii finale, informatia trebuie verificata in apelul activ.
